summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for Sparsh Pehla. All 30 backend tests passed (public content, auth, admin protected CRUD, forms). All frontend critical flows verified end-to-end: home, services (14 cards), service detail navigation, blog list + filters + detail, gallery, contact form submission, book consultation submission with success toast, admin login (valid/invalid), protected route redirect, admin dashboard stats, and logout clearing localStorage token.

issues: The italic gold accent word 'Motherhood' in hero headline has low contrast against the cream/light background — consider deeper gold or stronger weight for readability
The label 'MATERNITY & PARENTING WELLNESS' eyebrow text above the headline is very low contrast (pale gold on cream)

action_items: (Optional) Improve hero typography contrast for the italic 'Motherhood' word and the eyebrow label — both currently appear washed out against the light background image
(Optional) Admin dashboard /api/admin/stats returns additional fields (new_inquiries, pending_bookings, blogs, testimonials) that aren't surfaced in the UI — consider showing them as secondary stats
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 463 lines with all routes in one file — acceptable now but should be split into routers/auth.py, routers/public.py, routers/admin.py as it grows
Admin password fallback 'admin123' in seed_admin() is a security risk if ADMIN_PASSWORD env is ever unset; consider raising an exception instead of using a weak default
PATCH /admin/inquiries/{id} and similar endpoints do not validate that ObjectId is well-formed — invalid IDs raise bson.errors.InvalidId leaking 500. Wrap in try/except returning 400.
PATCH/DELETE admin endpoints don't verify the document existed before mutating (no 404) — silently returns 'Updated' / 'Deleted' for nonexistent IDs
Generic admin CRUD accepts arbitrary dict payload without validation — could pollute documents with bad fields. Consider per-collection Pydantic schemas
No rate limiting / brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (auth_testing.md recommends lockout after 5 failed attempts)
Cookie set with samesite='none', secure=True — fine for cross-origin preview but ensure JWT_SECRET is strong and rotated
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed inquiries/bookings/testimonials and clean up via DELETE endpoints. One leftover newsletter row for test_news_idem@example.com (idempotent test) and a residual TEST_User inquiry visible in admin dashboard during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints work as specified. Auth uses JWT Bearer token returned in login response and also sets httponly cookie. Frontend stores token as 'sp_token' in localStorage and sends via Authorization header via api.js interceptor. Admin dashboard shows 4 cards (inquiries/bookings/subscribers/services) plus 3 tabs (Inquiries/Bookings/Subscribers). Services count is 14 confirmed. Booking form uses custom shadcn-style date/time pickers (not native). data-testid coverage is excellent across all interactive elements.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no critical issues found. Implementation is solid; only minor design contrast suggestions and code-quality improvements (split server.py, validate ObjectIds, rate-limit login).
